oneLine: Fusion CX plans an IPO worth Rs 702 crore, providing promoter liquidity.

sources.title: Fusion CX Bets On AI And Customer Experience With ₹702 Crore IPO.

synopsis: Fusion CX Limited is preparing for an Initial Public Offering worth Rs 702 crore, providing promoter liquidity. The IPO will open on October 14, 2026, and close on October 16, 2026, with the price band fixed at Rs 275 to Rs 289 per share. The total issue comprises a fresh issue of shares worth Rs 500 crore and an Offer for Sale worth Rs 202 crore. Net proceeds from the fresh issue will be utilized for debt repayment amounting to Rs 275 crore, investment in subsidiaries amounting to Rs 61 crore, as well as business expansion and general corporate purposes. Bidding for anchor investors is scheduled to open on October 13, 2026.
